cases.title: Cross-browser compatibility — la page d'accueil the-internet se charge sur chromium et firefox

execution_profile.intent_summary: Verify that the public the-internet home page loads successfully and shows its main welcome heading for cross-browser smoke coverage.
expected_observations: The base URL is reachable and loads without requiring authentication.
The home page renders the main heading text 'Welcome to the-internet'.
The visible page state is sufficient for equivalent verification across Chromium and Firefox runs.
